title: iPhone 14 • 128GB — demo brief
goal: Show the phone honestly and drive a WhatsApp enquiry for the single unit.
audience: Buyers in Maracay comparing a used iPhone against a new one.
tone: Direct, warm, no hype. The product does the talking.

story.hook: A clean iPhone 14 for $330 — is it real?

beats.audio: Bed continues; tactile click on the box
beats.motion: Price pill enters with a short rise

beats.visual: Screen, Face ID and settings walk-through
beats.motion: One caption card per proof point

beats.visual: Edges and ports, then a clean hero frame
beats.audio: Music opens; sub hit on the hero frame

beats.visual: Product hero with footer and price
beats.audio: Riser ends on the final frame; tail pad

story.cta: Escríbenos por WhatsApp antes de que se vaya.
decisions: Hook-Retain-Reward over AIDA: one unit, one clear proof arc
